question: Where are the 'two most suggested and one suggested' proposals and the Approve/Reject buttons?

answer.mounted_under_step: location_evidence (displayed as 'Business review and research goals')
answer.renders_below: Project1ResearchStagePanel(stageNumber: 3), so it sits below the stage panel and is out of frame in a 1100px-high viewport

observed_proposals.source: m2_bdj_objective_proposals, actor GUC set to the owner (RLS otherwise returns 0 rows)
observed_proposals.conclusion: 2 MOST_SUGGESTED + 1 SUGGESTED on assessment 053b3768, all already APPROVED. A separate V1 assessment (e0124bfd) contains a REJECTED proposal, so both buttons have been exercised.

why_not_visible_now: The reachable assessment in the UI is marketplace assessment 37bf879a, which maps via m2_assessment_links to M2 assessment 032d3dde-547f-49a6-9e0f-58fbc5f1a48f.

032d3dde is a V1 assessment (the page renders M2V1-09/10/11 chips) and has ZERO objective proposals, so the panel correctly renders its empty state: 'No objective proposals are persisted for this confirmation.'
Zero proposals means no badges and no Approve/Reject buttons - there is nothing to decide.

integration_gap.statement: The assessment that produced the governed BDJ proposals (053b3768, M2V2) has no row in m2_assessment_links, so it is unreachable through normal navigation. The only linked assessment (37bf879a -> 032d3dde) is a V1 assessment with no proposals.
integration_gap.evidence: m2_assessment_links contains exactly 1 row: marketplace 37bf879a -> m2 032d3dde. No link references 053b3768.
integration_gap.consequence: Browser-driven verification of the proposal panel with populated proposals (and of Approve/Reject on live data) is BLOCKED. Backend verification through the authenticated API route remains available and is reported separately as BACKEND_INTEGRATION_VERIFIED.
integration_gap.not_a_defect_in: The panel widget itself - it renders correctly for both the populated and empty cases; the defect is the missing link row.
